verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for an AI API, so the axis applies. None of the evidence items mention training-data opt-out, zero data retention, or any data-usage policy; they cover search, agents, MCP, SDKs, routing, and pricing. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
